description: This Java source file defines the CommonWidgetModels class, which contains nested classes modeling widget components such as links, images, parameters, and auto-parameter configurations for a web framework. It provides methods for constructing widget elements, managing parameters, and referencing external services and entities within the OFBiz framework.

classes.name: CommonWidgetModels
classes.description: A collection of shared/reused widget models for the OFBiz framework, including nested classes for widget components and parameter management.

classes.name: AutoEntityParameters
classes.description: Handles automatic entity parameter extraction based on XML configuration, supporting inclusion/exclusion of fields and entity lookup.

classes.name: AutoServiceParameters
classes.description: Handles automatic service parameter extraction based on XML configuration, supporting exclusion of fields and service lookup.

classes.name: Image
classes.description: Models an image element with properties like source, alt text, style, and URL mode, supporting expansion with context.

classes.name: Link
classes.description: Models a hyperlink element with properties such as URL, target, parameters, embedded image, and callback handling, supporting expansion with context.

classes.name: Parameter
classes.description: Represents a widget parameter, supporting static values, dynamic expressions, and extraction from events or fields.

classes.name: ParameterFactory
classes.description: Factory class for creating Parameter instances from map entries.

methods.name: getParametersMap
methods.description: Generates a map of parameters for entity or service auto-parameters based on context and configuration.

methods.name: propagateCallbackInParameterMap
methods.description: Adds callback tokens to parameter map if callbacks are present or propagated.
